preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output must be a string.
The output string must contain only alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: output[0].isupper() and all(output[i].islower() for i in range(1, len(output)))
postconditions.description: The first character of the output string must be uppercase, and all subsequent characters must be lowercase.
